grammar.0.note: Use short, clear sentences in a meeting; at the end confirm who does what (Wer? Was? Bis wann?).
grammar.1.note: Minutes are usually written in the passive and in the Präteritum/Perfekt; for responsibility use „von + Dativ“.
grammar.2.note: When assigning tasks, always make the three questions clear: Wer – Was – Bis wann?
quiz.4.prompt: Which is normal to write in the Protokoll?
quiz.6.prompt: Distributing tasks — which three questions matter?
quiz.9.prompt: Put the sentence in order: “The task will be done by Friday.”
